description: This file defines a RemoteSessionService class responsible for fetching and managing remote session data, including session metadata, messages, and conversation history, from a cloud service. It interacts with external modules like vscode, SessionManager, and fetchSignedBlob.

classes.name: RemoteSessionService
classes.description: A service class for fetching remote session data, including session lists, messages, and full session context for resuming sessions.

methods.name: fetchRemoteSessions
methods.description: Fetches a list of remote sessions from the cloud, returning an array of RemoteSession objects.

methods.name: fetchSessionMessages
methods.description: Retrieves messages for a specific session by session ID, returning an array of ClineMessage or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionDataForResume
methods.description: Fetches full session data including UI messages and API conversation history for resuming a session.

methods.name: fetchApiHistoryFromBlobUrl
methods.description: Fetches API conversation history from a signed blob URL.

methods.name: getSessionMessageBlobUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the blob URL for session messages.

methods.name: fetchMessagesFromBlobUrl
methods.description: Fetches messages from a blob URL and filters out checkpoint saved messages.

methods.name: getSessionManager
methods.description: Initializes and returns the SessionManager instance or null if unavailable.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the output channel.
